constraints.message: Cab is quoted all-in. One Offer Rate including printing and mounting, with a duration beside it. There is no separate printing column on the cab sheet.
A roadshow day is 6 hours and 50 km. Additional time is Rs 1,000 per hour per cab and additional distance Rs 20 per km.
Permission cost varies by location and is not in the master. Exact locations must be confirmed before the plan is final.
A client representative must be present at the installation venue.

do: Show the all-in rate and the duration side by side.
State that a travelled-area report is provided at campaign end.
dont: Never add a separate printing line to a cab sheet, it is already in the rate.

approved: We require one of your personnel to be present at the venue where the Installation work will be going on.
Two-sided photographs will be provided of each cab after the installation work gets over.
The detailed customized report with all the areas travelled by each cab during the month will be provided at the end of the campaign.
Lead time will be of 7 Days after the Approval on the Final creative.
Roadshow Duration will be 6 Hours, with 50 Kms
Additional Time to be Charges Rs. 1,000/- Per Hour Per Cab & Additional Kms to be Charges Rs. 20/- Per Kms
Permission Cost Vary Location to Location, and for the same Before Confirming the Exact Locations will be Required.
